title: Rails
tagline: Rails are dynamically generated, interactive maps that visualise interactions such as transactional and quantitive activity over time.
description:
Rails are dynamically generated, interactive maps that visualise interactions such as transactional and quantitive activity over time. Each 'Rail' on the map represents and account, address, contract, protocol or entity of some kind (such as a bridge or exchange). To view activities on Rails the user scrolls vertically through a timeline. Rails can be set against metrics such as price. Creating a beautiful and easy to understand view of activity on the blockchain. To generate Rails input any blockchain address into the Rails app*. 

*Rails is in early design stages, contact Telegram @milodon
how_its_made: The example provided, demonstrating activity on Ricochet/Superfluid, was created from an existing framework built with HTML and CSS. At the time of this showcase Rails is static HTML/CSS with a little jQuery. Rails will become a fully functioning app which dynamically generates maps formed from data providers such as The Graph.
